messages:
nina: FYI customer reported that our /v1/rerank docs say scores are sorted highest->lowest, but actual API returns scores in ascending order (low->high). Their integration picks index 0 as best and got the worst result.

raj: Oof. Where in docs?

nina: API ref rerank response example (docs/snippets/json/rerank-response.json) shows an array with scores in descending order and text: 'results sorted by score (high->low)'. The runtime returns ascending. Customer provided response sample proving it.

lucy: That mismatch would definitely break simple integrations. Quick fix: update wording to "scores are returned low->high" and add an example snippet showing how to pick top result by sorting descending.

raj: Is this a docs-only issue or should runtime change?

nina: Customer is on Hosted and has existing integrations; prefer docs change + migration note. But we should check whether other clients (SDKs) assume descending.

lucy: I'll grep SDKs for .r[0] usage or assumptions. If SDK helpers (e.g., rerankBest) assume order, we need to patch them too.

qa-bot: Quick tests: added a small test that calls /v1/rerank and asserts scores[0] >= scores[-1] — it failed (scores[0] < scores[-1]). Posting sample: [{"id":0,"score":0.12},{"id":1,"score":0.86}]

raj: Thanks @qa-bot. We'll update docs to reflect actual behavior and add a migration note: "Do not assume ordering; sort by score descending or use provided SDK helper (coming)."

lucy: I'll open a PR to change the OpenAPI example response ordering, update the textual description, and add a short code snippet for Node and Python showing a safe pattern: sort by score descending, then pick 0.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 by lucy — changes: openapi rerank example, node/python snippets, migration-note. CI: docs-lint passed.

nina: Customer prefers docs update. Can we include a small migration section showing the minimal change for existing code that uses array[0]? e.g., `results.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score); const best=results[0];`

lucy: Yep will add that and mention potential performance implications for very large result sets; recommend SDK helper once released.

raj: I'll search backend history to confirm whether behavior ever flipped. If runtime changed recently we need to coordinate a changelog entry.

qa-bot: Test matrix: updated rerank integration tests to not assume ordering; added explicit sort assertion in new tests.

nina: Ok shipping docs PR now; ping me when staged so I can share with the customer.

docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 — merged to main. Staging docs refreshed.

lucy: Follow-up: I'll open a small SDK PR to add a helper `pickBest(results)` that sorts and returns top-k. ETA EOD.

nina: Thanks all — customer confirmed fix works after switching to sorted selection. Marking resolved unless any regressions.
